row.notes: myteam-g2: Creates the My Team entrant from the completed setup data: removes the previous player team/vehicle (Ent_EntrantsSystem_RemoveTeam/RemoveVehicle using setup+0x2e0/0x2e4), builds the new team and car records from data (+0x14..+0xd8: names, colours, livery packed vec4 via Game_Customisation_GetPackedVec4WithKeyOverride), adds them with Ent_EntrantsSystem_AddTeam/AddVehicle, constructs Game_MyTeamDriverAttributeSet and Game_MyTeamTeamAttributeSet_FindOrCreate and applies Career_OwnerSetup_ApplySuit. Hook: the point where the My Team team record is created.
